title: Optimal values for the five-cycle
statement: For the weighted five-cycle on vertices indexed by $ br/5 br$, with weight $1/10$ on each ordered adjacent pair and zero weight otherwise, the weights are nonnegative and symmetric, sum to $1$, and vanish on the diagonal; its maximum cut value is $4/5$. The assignment placing vertex $v$ at the unit vector with first two coordinates $(\\cos(4\\pi v/5),\\sin(4\\pi v/5))$ and all other coordinates zero has SDP value $(1-\\cos(4\\pi/5))/2$, and this value is the SDP optimum.
